how: Named by hand on 2026-10-02 (user, French titles; English renders translated) from the best-log-density mode, reading each axis's benchmarks by share of their loading variance on the reference-aligned view. Refit the same day (release nodes, reasoning-off offsets): the best mode is now chains 1, 5, 7 of 8 (mode B, chains 0, 2-4 and 6, sits 29 nats lower); axes 2 and 3 correlate at 0.97 and axis 2 is led by Chess Puzzles (share 0.64), so it was renamed Puzzles & Core Scientific Knowledge (user, in English; French title translated). A title is applied only while one of its signature benchmarks stays among the axis's top benchmarks by share.
